gloss: land sold in lots; subdivided land

definitions.gloss: land sold in lots; subdivided land for sale
definitions.explanation: A tract of land that has been divided into individual lots and sold to buyers, typically for building houses. A key concept in Japanese residential real estate.

examples.japanese: {分譲地|ぶんじょうち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for subdivided land for sale.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{近|ちか}い→近い：00530_chikai⟧{分譲地|ぶんじょうち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: Subdivided lots near the station are popular.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{分譲地|ぶんじょうち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦され→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{次々|つぎつぎ}→次々：03522_tsugitsugi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{建|た}てられている→建てる：01189_tateru⟧。
examples.english: New subdivided lots have been developed, and houses are being built one after another.

notes:
USAGE:
A real estate term commonly seen in advertisements and housing discussions. ⟦{分譲|ぶんじょう}→分譲：06577_bunjou⟧ means "selling in lots" and appears in compounds like ⟦{分譲|ぶんじょう}→分譲：06577_bunjou⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧ (condominium for sale) and ⟦{分譲|ぶんじょう}{住宅|じゅうたく}→分譲住宅：23884_bunjoujuutaku⟧ (house built on subdivided land).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {分譲地|ぶんじょうち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧ (to buy a lot)
- {分譲地|ぶんじょうち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧ (to look for lots)
- {分譲地|ぶんじょうち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧ (development of subdivided land)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{宅地|たくち}→宅地：21589_takuchi⟧: residential land — a broader term for any land designated for housing
- ⟦{分譲|ぶんじょう}→分譲：06577_bunjou⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧: condominium for sale — an apartment unit sold rather than rented
